current.text: Experts rank him around 8th to 10th in 9-cat leagues, behind Jayson Tatum and Anthony Edwards. He is not worth pick 5 but is fine at pick 6 or later.
Josh would pay no more than 45 USD for him in an auction.
He went for 48 USD in an expert auction mock draft.
If he is nominated early in an auction, he can go well below his value.
He is projected for about 31 usage in 34 minutes.
Detroit lost creation with Tobias Harris and has very few creators besides him.
His usage may go up after the roster changes. A bigger offensive load could hurt his FG% and FT%.
He led his group in potential assists (24.7 per 100), so his assists could go over 10 per game unless Daniss Jenkins takes a bigger role.
The team wants him to get more catch-and-shoot threes, with Ausar Thompson running some of the offense.
Detroit's projected starting five is the same as last season, with him at guard.
Detroit is projected for 50 to 51 wins and a third or fourth seed in the East.
Detroit plays 4, 3 and 4 games in our playoff weeks 19 to 21. The team has 15 back-to-backs, and no rest is expected.

durable.text: He is an elite assist source. Assists are his best category by far.
He commits many turnovers, which clearly hurts the TO category.
He carries a heavy creation load. This hurts his finishing and two-point percentage, so FG% is a mild weakness.
His free throws are fine but not strong. Experts want his FT% back over 85%.
He has a spotty injury history. It includes a punctured lung, a lung issue at the end of last season, and lower body problems in recent years.
One expert is not particularly worried about his injury history.
He is worth more in points leagues than in 9-cat. He could finish ahead of Shai Gilgeous-Alexander in points but only around 8th or 9th in categories.
Detroit is built on defense. The front office wants only enough offense.

note: The market prices him as a top 5 player (Yahoo 64.4 USD average cost, ESPN 56.6 USD, 55 USD in our league last season), but category experts rank him 8th to 10th and cap him at 45 USD, so let others pay 55 USD or more. He fits a punt TO build best, where his elite assists, points and steals count fully and his 3.9 turnovers cost nothing. Early in the season, check whether his assists go over 10 and whether the bigger load drags his FG% and FT% down.
